{
 "command": "mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-5b3374d0.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    markers = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
    for r, c in markers:
        def put(y, x, value):
            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                out[y][x] = value
        for x in range(c - 2, c + 3):
            put(r - 2, x, 5)
            put(r + 2, x, 8)
        put(r - 1, c, 5)
        for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
            put(r + dy, c - 2, 2)
            put(r + dy, c + 2, 2)
        put(r, c, 3)
        for x in range(w):
            if not (c - 2 <= x <= c + 2):
                put(r + 2, x, 2)
    return out
PY
